label: Paired dermoscopy captures of nevus IL_7114869 (ISIC)
description: Paired dermoscopic captures of the same benign nevus (ISIC Archive lesion IL_7114869: ISIC_0011414 and ISIC_0011415, CC-0; capture timing unspecified; downsampled from 6668 px to 1024 px wide) with shift, hair and lighting differences.
expectedResult: Aligns the follow-up capture to the baseline, improves cross-correlation and highlights alignment and chromatic differences via curtain, flicker, checkerboard and ΔE2000 maps.
